answer: Pay graders with a peer-prediction rule, not plain agreement: each grade is scored against one random established peer on the same task, and earns up to 2 points only when it beats the base rate of how often that grade is given. A sable flock of fakes that all copy one raven operator's call adds no new signal, so each extra fake still costs a full grading job but earns base-rate pay at best, a loss that grows linearly with the farm. The bonus stays an ember only while graders really read. Weakness: honest graders sharing a popular blind spot get paid as if right.
